name: Exp_EMA-Crossover_Signal
summary: This EA trades based on the EMA-Crossover_Signal custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward crossover signals and sell positions on downward crossover signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggle controls for opening and closing positions on both sides. The strategy operates on new bar events with a historical bar lookup to determine if opposing positions should be closed.
summary_zh: 该EA基于EMA-Crossover_Signal自定义指标进行交易，在向上交叉信号时开多仓，在向下交叉信号时开空仓。它支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈，以及买卖双边开平仓的独立开关控制。策略在新K线事件触发时运行，并通过历史K线回溯判断是否应平掉反向持仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于两条不同周期的移动平均线交叉信号，快速MA上穿慢速MA产生买入信号，下穿产生卖出信号。入场条件为EMA-Crossover_Signal指标在指定SignalBar位置输出非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的信号值，UpValue触发做多、DnValue触发做空。出场条件包括止损和止盈参数控制，同时在开启反向平仓时，EA会遍历历史K线寻找更早期的反向信号来决定是否平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制交易手数比例，支持五种资金管理模式：自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后自由保证金、扣除亏损后余额和固定手数。资金管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准化模块，提供从固定手数到基于不同保证金计算方式的动态仓位调整。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a crossover of two moving averages with different periods, where the faster MA crossing above the slower MA generates a buy signal and vice versa for sell signals. Entry conditions require the EMA-Crossover_Signal indicator to output a non-zero and non-EMPTY_VALUE signal at the specified SignalBar position, with UpValue triggering long entries and DnValue triggering short entries. Exit conditions include configurable stop loss and take profit in points, and when reverse-close toggles are enabled, the EA scans historical bars to find earlier opposing signals to determine whether to close existing positions. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the lot ratio, supporting five money management modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. The money management leverages the standardized TradeAlgorithms.mqh library module, providing dynamic position sizing ranging from fixed lots to margin-calculated approaches based on different equity metrics.

parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

parameters.description_en: Money management mode (free margin/balance/post-loss margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot)

pros: 提供独立的开仓和平仓开关，灵活性高，可以只做单向交易或只平仓不开仓
支持五种资金管理模式，从固定手数到基于保证金动态计算，满足不同风险偏好
使用IsNewBar机制控制信号计算频率，避免同一根K线内重复触发交易
止损止盈参数完整，默认止损1000点止盈2000点，盈亏比2:1较为合理
代码结构清晰，使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库封装交易逻辑，减少重复代码
pros_en: Provides independent toggle switches for opening and closing positions on both sides, offering high flexibility for unidirectional or close-only trading configurations
Supports five money management modes from fixed lots to dynamic margin-based sizing, accommodating various risk appetites
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to control signal calculation frequency, preventing duplicate trade triggers within the same bar
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters with a default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio (1000 SL vs 2000 TP)
Clean code structure leveraging the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for trade logic encapsulation, reducing code duplication
cons: 快速MA周期5和慢速MA周期6差距过小，容易产生频繁的虚假交叉信号导致过度交易
反向平仓逻辑遍历所有历史K线（for循环无上限优化），在长历史数据上可能导致性能问题
没有点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下信号可能被噪声淹没导致不利入场
依赖iCustom调用外部指标EMA-Crossover_Signal，增加了部署复杂性和依赖风险
Recount标志在CopyBuffer失败时置为true但在下次tick才重新计算，可能在快速行情中延迟信号
cons_en: The FastMA period of 5 and SlowMA period of 6 are too close, which can generate frequent false crossover signals leading to overtrading
The reverse-close logic iterates through all historical bars without an upper bound optimization, potentially causing performance issues on long chart histories
No spread filter mechanism exists, so signals may be overwhelmed by noise in high-spread environments leading to unfavorable entries
Depends on iCustom calling the external EMA-Crossover_Signal indicator, adding deployment complexity and dependency risk
The Recount flag is set to true on CopyBuffer failure but only recalculates on the next tick, potentially delaying signals during fast market moves
improvements: 增大快速MA和慢速MA的周期差距（如5和20），或增加信号确认机制（如要求信号持续2-3根K线）以减少虚假信号
为反向平仓的历史K线遍历添加最大搜索范围限制，避免在超长历史数据上不必要的性能消耗
增加点差过滤和波动率过滤，在高点差或低波动率环境下抑制交易信号
improvements_en: Increase the gap between FasterMA and SlowerMA periods (e.g., 5 and 20), or add signal confirmation requiring the signal to persist for 2-3 bars to reduce false signals
Add a maximum search range limit to the historical bar iteration for reverse-close logic to avoid unnecessary performance overhead on very long chart histories
Add spread filter and volatility filter to suppress trading signals in high-spread or low-volatility environments

risk_points: 快速MA和慢速MA周期差距仅1，产生频繁虚假信号可能导致连续亏损
反向平仓逻辑遍历所有历史K线无上限，存在性能和逻辑风险
缺乏点差过滤和最大持仓检查，可能在不利条件下频繁开仓
risk_points_en: The minimal 1-period gap between Fast and Slow MA generates frequent false signals that can lead to consecutive losses
The reverse-close logic iterates through all historical bars without an upper bound, posing performance and logic risks
Lack of spread filter and maximum position check may cause frequent entries under unfavorable conditions
